feed.summary: v40: Shade's Shadow moved from post-roll to pre-roll. Fires with Ember Force Swarm now.

feed.summary: Fixed pre-roll callout timing — `doPreRollSetup` now returns the count of queued callouts, and `rollReady` computes `preRollDelay = N × 1500ms` so dice never fire mid-callout; previously the DOM-presence check happened before any `setTimeout`s fired (so delay was always 0), causing dice to roll instantly over SWARM!, FORGE!, NAP!, and SEASONS! splashes.
feed.next_up: Fix the broken single-slash "comments" (`/ Helper:`, `/ Smithy`, `/ Mother Nature`) — these stray `/` characters are latent JS parse hazards that look like division operators and will silently break the game under any minification or strict-mode build pass.
feed.after_that: Pressure opponent auto-pick feedback — when the opponent has only 1 sideline ghost, `doPressureSwap` executes instantly with no callout to the *attacking* player; both players should see the callout splash before the swap executes, not notice it already happened silently.

feed.summary: Queued pre-roll callouts (SWARM!, ASCEND!, FORGE!, NAP!, all SEASONS!) into a staggered `setTimeout` sequence so simultaneous pre-roll triggers (e.g., Ember Force + Mother Nature) now play one after the other instead of the second instantly stomping the first.
feed.next_up: Audit the `doTeamRoll` outer-block path — after Cycle 34's fix changed the `rollReady` guard to `phase !== 'ready'`, the `btn.classList.add('locked')` and `doTeamRoll` calls that sit *outside* that if-block still fire unconditionally; verify those lines are guarded and can't fire when phase has been interrupted mid-pre-roll-setup (KO-swap or game-over).
feed.after_that: Fix the broken single-slash stray comments (`/ Helper:`, `/ Smithy`, `/ Mother Nature`) — these are latent JS parse hazards that look like division operators and will silently break the game under any minification or strict-mode build pass.

feed.summary: Fixed `rollReady` silently rolling dice during an Ember-Force-triggered KO-swap — the old guard only caught `phase === 'over'`, so when Ember Force killed the active ghost with replacements still available, `phase` became `'ko-swap'`, the check was missed, phase was overwritten to `'rolling'`, and dice fired while the KO-swap picker was on screen; changed the guard to `phase !== 'ready'` so any mid-pre-roll interruption (game-over, ko-swap, or future states) aborts the roll.
feed.next_up: Queue the pre-roll callouts — Ember Force (SWARM!), Smithy (FORGE!), Maximo (NAP!), and Mother Nature (SEASONS!) all call `showAbilityCallout` directly in `doPreRollSetup`, so when two of them fire the same round (e.g., Red Ember Force vs. Blue Mother Nature), the second callout instantly stomps the first; convert these to `queueAbility` with a pre-roll queue block and drain before the dice roll fires.
feed.after_that: Audit the `doTeamRoll` path for the second-click case (B.phase === 'rolling') — when the KO-swap guard was broken, the `btn.classList.add('locked')` and `doTeamRoll` calls outside the `if (B.phase === 'ready')` block still fired; verify those outer lines are also safe when the phase has been interrupted.
